language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The spoon is initially lifted in frames 60–67 (wrist_left), but falls back onto the tabletop beside the box in frames 68–75 (ceiling, wrist_left, wrist_right). The robot reacquires and lifts it in frames 103–115, then releases it inside the blue box in frames 133–137 (wrist_right). It remains in the box after the gripper withdraws through frame 157 (ceiling). Completion follows one failed retention attempt; no damage or unrelated side effects are visible.

failure_annotations.explanation: After the spoon is visibly lifted and carried in frames 60–67 (wrist_left), it falls away from the gripper beginning at frame 68 and settles on the tabletop outside the box by frames 70–75 (ceiling, wrist_left). The empty gripper and separated spoon are also visible in wrist_right. Loss of retention interrupts the transfer.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reapproach the spoon at its new tabletop position, secure its handle, verify retention with a small lift, and carry it over the box before releasing; no human intervention is needed.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The spoon lands on the tabletop beside the box without visible damage, spill, or disruption to other objects.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The spoon remains accessible on the tabletop and the box remains in place; another grasp can be attempted without environmental resetting or human intervention.
